chapter: Dizzy, Chano Pozo and Afro-Cuban jazz
title: Recommending conga players for the Town Hall concert
summary: Gillespie asks him for players; Chano Pozo is chosen and Chino declines.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Uh-huh. So he was playing -- he played a few times with you --
-- he come over there, you know, sit down.
Right. And when you say he asked for you to recommend some people, was this before the Town Hall concert or was this for the Town Hall concert.
What was Chica Tiko's second name? Do you know?
He got a -- last name is Nacion (phonetic). He never changed his last name.
But he was (inaudible) Chica Tiko. Was he the man who ran a band at the Morocco at one stage?
No, that was Chiquitos Alvarez. Chica Tiko used to play bongo with the malleto in Casino de la Playa orchestra. And then he came here and joined the --

Acion -- I think I had the name Acion. So they went to the rehearsal, and I see this (inaudible) go haywire, say, man, this is it. And then he get ready to (inaudible) told me, say, Mario, I don't want to be bothered, because I know they're going to -- next thing they're going to do, they're going to start traveling, and I don't want to be bothered with it. So I say, Chano, how about you? Chano say, no (inaudible). So that's that.
And then, naturally, (inaudible) word from Chano. Chano was a composer. Chano has so many things. So there was -- there was a life (inaudible) Dizzy Gillespie (inaudible) upset everybody.
Did you go to the Town Hall concert?
